name: Can Hometelligent Inc. install a range hood in an older home in Oakland that lacks existing ventilation?
description: We install range hoods in older Oakland homes, with or without existing ventilation. We assess ductwork routing and structural impact for optimal results.

mainEntity.name: Can Hometelligent Inc. install a range hood in an older home in Oakland that lacks existing ventilation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Hometelligent Inc. can install a range hood in older homes in Oakland, even those without existing ventilation. This typically involves installing new ductwork through walls or ceilings to the exterior, or configuring a ductless (recirculating) system. For older properties, a key decision factor is the potential impact on existing structures and the most efficient routing for new ventilation, which we assess to ensure minimal disruption and optimal performance.
